div.head: II As 2.2
div.ab: ⁊ se ðe hine ofor þæt feormige, forgylde hine be his were oððe hine be ðam geladie.
⁊ se ðe hine ofer ðæt feormige, forgylde hine be his were oþþe he hine be ðam ladige.
⁊ se ðe hine ofer þæt feormige, forgeld hine be his were oððe hine be ðam ladige.
Qui eum postea firmabit, persoluat eum wera sua uel sic neget.
⁊ se ðe hine ofer ðæt feormige, forgylde hine be his were oþþe he hine be ðam ladige.
And he who harbours him after he has been declared an outlaw, shall pay for him to the amount of his wergeld, or clear himself with an oath of equivalent value.
And he who harbours him after that, is to pay for him with his wergild or to clear himself by an oath of that amount.
Und wer ihn fernerhin beherbergt, bezahle ihn mit dessen Wergeld oder reinige sich [durch Eid] im Werthe dieses [Wergelds].
And whoever harbours him after that, let him pay for him with his wergild or clear himself [by oath] to the value of that [wergild].
